_comment: Every template the scnehaux theme copies from keycloak.v2 (TDD-identity-kernel-004 §Override Surface). Each copy is the stock template of the pinned release with exactly these replacements; cmd/theme-overrides proves it against the image, so a release that changes or fixes the template fails CI until the copy is re-made or removed.

overrides.reason: The username macro labels its read-only field with for="username", while the field's id is kc-attempted-username, so on every page after the first (the one-time code, the passkey) the field has no accessible name (WCAG 2.2 1.3.1, 4.1.2). Found by axe-core in browser/.
overrides.remove_when: the pinned release labels the attempted-username field; cmd/theme-overrides then fails because the stock text is gone

overrides.reason: The two labels of the one-time-code enrolment page name an id no element has, so the code and device-name fields have no accessible name (WCAG 2.2 1.3.1, 4.1.2). Found by axe-core in browser/.
overrides.remove_when: the pinned release labels both fields; cmd/theme-overrides then fails because the stock text is gone

overrides.reason: Each choice on the authenticator selection page is a div with role button and tabindex 0 that acts on click alone, so a person without a pointer reaches it by Tab and cannot activate it (WCAG 2.2 2.1.1). The WAI-ARIA button pattern activates a button on Enter and on Space; the copy adds that handler and nothing else. Found by the keyboard path in browser/; axe-core does not test activation.
overrides.upstream: https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak/issues/45227 (closed by 6550d1b, which added the role and tabindex but no key handler)
overrides.remove_when: the pinned release activates a choice from the keyboard; cmd/theme-overrides then fails because the stock text is gone
